jobs.description: DHL Group is the world’s leading logistics provider. We connect people and markets and enable global trade. Your work will cover emerging frameworks such as ReFuelEU Aviation, RED III and ICAO CORSIA, as well as innovative concepts such as Book & Claim. International legal qualifications are explicitly welcome.* Several years of relevant legal advisory experience, ideally gained within an international corporate environment.* Strong knowledge of ESG, energy, fuels and/or related regulatory matters. Experience in aviation or energy is an advantage.* Extensive experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements.* The ability to analyse regulatory change and translate it into practical recommendations and implementation approaches.* Fluent written and spoken English, including the ability to negotiate effectively. German and additional languages are advantageous.* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management capabilities and the confidence to work independently in a rapidly evolving international regulatory environment.       Why Join This Role? This is an opportunity to take ownership of legal topics that sit directly at the intersection of aviation, sustainability, regulation and international commerce.Rather than advising from the sidelines, you will work closely with the business to help turn evolving regulatory requirements into commercial solutions and contribute to DHL Group's wider decarbonization ambitions Your Benefits* Flexibility: Work remotely for up to three days per week, combined with flexible working hours and no core working hours. jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionAre you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.Requirements- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external contextAdditional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare.
